title_en: Duplex for sale in Residence Diello, 3 parking spaces
description_en: At the "Diellon" Residence, we sell a Super Duplex with a courtyard. With a construction area of ​​240 m2 and a yard area of ​​54.76 m2. The duplex is organized: on the first floor with a living room, a separate kitchen, a toilet and a green yard, on the second floor: 4 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms and a laundry room. Orientation from the South-West gives the duplex the opportunity to have light and natural lighting during most of the day. It is located in one of the highest quality residences in the Mjull Bathore area, which is nearing completion. Extra works have been done on the property by the current owner, such as a functional fireplace, high quality electrical and plumbing materials, additional insulation system, etc. It has 3 parking spaces. For more information or a visit to this property, do not hesitate to contact us
